purpose: Necessary-condition diagnostic of frozen targets; no observational refits or new significance tests.
scalar_model: Stationary spherical zero-flux charged dilute scalar, same frozen baryonic force proxy, fixed Mphi/reduced_Mpl=1.
normalization: q/Vt^2 = 1-c*x; c=(m0/m)^2>=0; x=-R U_sc,0_prime/Vt^2. Both contact and quantum terms scale with c.
primary_sample: All reliable outer points; preserve all failures and signs. Also report active-envelope and per-galaxy subsets.
criterion: Analytic minimax inf over c>=0 of max_i |1-c*x_i|. Report infimum at infinite mass explicitly, not as a finite solution.
uncertainty: Frozen target/calibration only. No propagated empirical parameter covariance, no observational goodness-of-fit probability.
constructive_phase: Compare the original eta=pi/2 lift to contact-minimizing constant eta=pi in the declared parent. Density and composition-gradient stress unchanged.
remaining_conditions: Phase minimization is not satisfaction of both amplitude equations, gravity, stability, or population formation.
velocity_bound: Replace illustrative population fraction by |v2-v1|>=2sqrt(q) for positive tangential demand; bound is conditional on that closure.
